# id: # The one list of sound events. The CLI, the bar panel and the README table all
# read it; the hooks that fire each event live in hypr/, bin/soundswap-daemon

label: Shutdown
hint: Shut down, reboot or log out

label: Password prompt
hint: An app asks for your password

label: Fullscreen
hint: A window goes fullscreen or maximized

label: Leave fullscreen
hint: A window goes back to normal size

label: Menu open
hint: Omarchy menu or app launcher opens

label: Menu close
hint: Omarchy menu or app launcher closes

label: Device connected
hint: USB or Bluetooth device plugged in

label: System Update
hint: System packages and migrations finish; other update stages may follow
